title: Submit for Approval
subtitle: Review and submit this election for processing

approval_workflow.title: Approval Workflow
approval_workflow.paid_election_description: Elections with more than 40 expected voters require platform administrator review and approval. This typically takes 1-5 business days. You will receive an email notification when approved or rejected.
approval_workflow.free_election_description: Elections with 40 or fewer expected voters are automatically approved. Your election will move to the setup phase immediately upon submission.

submission_requirements.title: Submission Requirements
submission_requirements.subtitle: Verify these two items before submitting for approval:

setup_timing_info: Posts, candidates, and voters are configured during the administration phase — after this submission is approved.

button_titles.set_voter_count_first: Expected voter count is required before submitting
